scope: Selective primary-source audit; not an exhaustive novelty search

core_source_groups.label: Ashby: behavioral structure across material implementations
core_source_groups.access_note: Full text available and opening material inspected; the root research agent additionally inspected §§1/2–1/6. No claim of a complete rereading.

core_source_groups.label: Interface automata: environment assumptions are part of composition
core_source_groups.access_note: Full technical PDF, especially abstract and introduction, inspected. Its pagination differs from the published conference version.

core_source_groups.label: Open Petri nets: endpoint summaries lose interaction
core_source_groups.access_note: Full HTML inspected, especially §§3–6, Theorems 17, 23, 24 and the strict-inclusion counterexample. This distinction is stronger than the abstract alone suggests.

core_source_groups.label: Autocatalytic sets: prerequisite closure differs from actual maintenance
core_source_groups.access_note: Full text inspected, especially Background, Part I: Dynamics, food replenishment, and spontaneous seeding of subRAFs. No claim that its structural RAF condition alone proves indefinite persistence under finite support.

core_source_groups.label: Partial-observation games: information states require objective-specific memory
core_source_groups.access_note: Primary abstract and full HTML retrieved; the result stated above is explicitly in the abstract. This audit does not reproduce its complexity proofs.

core_source_groups.label: Unawareness: changing expressiveness is not ordinary uncertainty
core_source_groups.access_note: Full author PDF inspected, especially §2 and its description of the lattice and projections. Working-paper version and final article are distinguished.

core_source_groups.label: Institutional grammar: rules are not just physical constraints
core_source_groups.access_note: Publisher abstract and publication metadata inspected. A discovered full-PDF mirror failed to open. Detailed syntax and theorem-level claims are therefore not attributed on the basis of this session. The publisher's 2013 online date is not the article's original 1995 publication date.

core_source_groups.label: Price: selection is a decomposition, not an ethical direction
core_source_groups.access_note: The two-page 1970 scan was inspected; OCR is poor, so use the scan for exact notation. The 1972 scan was retrieved once but a repeat request timed out; detailed claims here rely on 1970. The 1972 DOI contains “1957” although the publisher verifies publication in 1972.

core_source_groups.label: Niche construction: selection can modify its resource environment
core_source_groups.access_note: Full article text was available in the search index, including abstract and model-discussion passages; direct opening encountered the site's browser check. Accordingly, no uninspected equation or theorem number is used here.

core_source_groups.label: Reflective rewriting: rules can be represented and transformed internally
core_source_groups.access_note: Primary publisher/research-group abstracts and the author's publication list inspected; full proofs not reviewed. Bibliographic pagination differs between the publisher record and author list, so page numbers are deliberately omitted pending reconciliation.

core_source_groups.label: Self-modifying agents: preservation results have a fixed evaluative reference
core_source_groups.access_note: Full PDF inspected at model setup, Theorem 16, and its subsequent qualifications. This is a formal conditional result, not evidence that deployed self-modifying systems satisfy its assumptions.

core_source_groups.label: Corrigibility: preserving correction mechanisms is already a design target
core_source_groups.access_note: Full paper inspected, particularly abstract, §1.1, and manipulation examples. Its open-problem statement describes that paper's result, not a claim about the entire field in 2026.
